title: GIS field semantics
description: `.gis/semantics.json` placed with the data: what the user declares fields and bands to mean. Entries are matched in order; a later entry overrides an earlier one for the same field or band.

match.description: Glob pattern relative to the directory holding `.gis/`, same rules as `sources`: `*` and `?` stay within one path segment, `**` spans segments.

layer.description: Vector layer the fields belong to; omitted means every layer of the matched dataset.

bands.description: Raster bands keyed by 1-based band number.

kind.description: Same values as gis-kit `quantity_type` / `quantity`: total (extensive, adds up over area), density (per unit area), ratio (dimensionless or per-unit rate, not per area), category (class codes).

note.description: User's own short remark, passed on verbatim as a quotation.
